summary: Wave 3 finalisation retest (iteration 9). ALL 3 P0 BLOCKERS FROM ITERATION_8 ARE FIXED. Backend wave3 suite: 21/21 executed PASS, 4 supplier-only SKIPPED (no approved-supplier seed in this env, expected). Critical fixes verified: (1) GET /api/listings/{nonexistent_uuid} → 404 (was 500 due to is_suspended column join), (2) GET /sitemap.xml at the public ingress now serves the real XML (urlset with /papers + Bangalore-aware URLs) instead of React HTML — verified via curl: `<?xml version=...><urlset...>` — content is correct because /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml is served by CRA static, (3) GET /robots.txt returns 200 and is reachable — the response body in this preview env is the platform-injected content-signals robots (acknowledged in brief as known preview-only behaviour; on production tonerscart.com the static /app/frontend/public/robots.txt will be served). Finance/Earnings/Papers/Reorder/Paginated-search/Duplicate/Apply-seller all green at backend. Frontend smoke (admin) confirmed: Admin Finance tab loads summary (Total GMV ₹1,72,942, Commission ₹12,740, Dealer Payouts ₹1,60,202, Active Dealers 10), Monthly summary table + Export CSV, Dealer payouts table + Export CSV — 2 download buttons present and clickable. Buyer dashboard loads 19 orders correctly (all REQUESTED → Reorder buttons gated correctly to delivered/cancelled, code exists at CustomerDashboard.jsx:46-184 with data-testid=`reorder-{order.id}`). Public routes /, /search (Load More button present), /papers, /forgot-password (email input present), /reset-password all render without crash. Supplier dashboard UI deferred (no approved-supplier seed credentials available — same constraint as iteration_8).

minor.issue: Returns 503 with hardcoded message referencing supabase_schema_papers.sql until the user runs the migration. Graceful degrade is per-spec; acceptable until migration is applied.

Preview ingress injects platform content-signals robots.txt body INSTEAD of /app/frontend/public/robots.txt. Acknowledged by main agent as a preview-environment-only behaviour; production tonerscart.com will serve the correct static file. Not a code defect.
Always returns {ok:true} even if downstream email send fails — no observability. Carry-over from iter_8 (out of wave-3 scope).

issues: Duplicate rows showing for 'TEST BizA' (Mumbai) across multiple rows with identical city/dealer name but different stats — likely separate dealer_ids sharing a business_name. Consider grouping or showing dealer_id/business_id suffix for disambiguation. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2705+ lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers/finance.py, routers/papers.py, routers/listings_paginated.py, routers/supplier_listings.py before any further wave lands. Carry-over from iter_8.
_RATE_BUCKETS in-memory dict has no eviction and is per-pod — under multi-pod k8s the limit is per-pod not global. Document for ops, target Redis for production.

/api/listings/search/paginated still slices an in-memory 2000-row cap from search_listings() — pages count becomes incorrect once active listings exceed 2000. Switch to PostgREST count+range before catalogue scales.
PUT /api/supplier/listings/{id} with no valid fields silently returns {ok:true, updated:[]} — callers cannot distinguish 'row missing' vs 'payload had nothing useful'. Should 400 on empty patch.
compress_image swallows Pillow exceptions and returns raw bytes — if a crafted payload bypasses Pillow we may persist the unmodified blob. Log at WARNING and reject unrecognised formats.
duplicate_listing copies ALL non-id columns including any future sku/slug uniques — defend by stripping unique fields explicitly.
sitemap_xml hardcodes base='https://www.tonerscart.com'; pull from env (SITEMAP_BASE_URL) so dev previews don't emit production canonicals if crawled.

Frontend hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from the Bangalore city picker — fix the option structure in App.js (line ~45 CartProvider area). Cosmetic React hydration noise but should be cleaned.
